A '''terrain-following sensor''' was a component that worked in tandem with a [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] propulsion and flight-control systems, allowing it to fly at a fixed height parallel to the ground. It automatically adjusted a ship's course and altitude to avoid collisions with obstacles and changing terrain.
